Hi there,

With food advent calendars selling out before Thanksgiving, shoppers want thoughtful countdowns without stale cardboard packaging. 

Sunday Cookie Co. in Brooklyn is launching our Holiday Box of 12 ($34) as a real-butter 12-day holiday countdown. Packed with fresh favorites like Brown Butter Chocolate Chip and Pumpkin Spice Snickerdoodle, it offers a bakery-fresh alternative to mass-market advent boxes.

We would love to send a sample box to your desk this week for holiday gift guide consideration. Let us know where to ship your fresh batch.

Warmly,
Mai
Sunday Cookie Co.

creator_brief.concept: Surprising a Friendsgiving host with a box of 12 warm cookies instead of boring wine.
creator_brief.creator: NYC food and lifestyle creator
creator_brief.hook: Stop bringing a bottle of wine to Friendsgiving.

radar.headline: Friendsgiving hosts want practical food gifts under $50, setting up our holiday boxes.

moves.steal: Position our 12-pack as the official Friendsgiving host gift on social.
moves.title: Practical Host Gifts Surge for Friendsgiving
moves.why_us: Our Holiday Box of 12 is the ultimate host gift to bring instead of wine.

moves.steal: Highlight our thick Brooklyn-style center bake with close-up break-apart videos.

moves.why_us: Category excitement is peaking right now as consumers look for premium treats.

moves.happened: Major food brands launched early Black Friday promotions with up to 40% off curated items.
moves.steal: Promote our free shipping threshold for December holiday boxes proactively.
moves.title: Early Black Food Deals Drive Volume
moves.why_us: Shoppers are buying food gifts earlier than ever before the December rush.

trends.insight: 52% of younger Americans host Friendsgiving, seeking practical gifts under $50.
trends.move: Position box as the ultimate host gift.
trends.name: Friendsgiving Host Gift Demand
trends.risk: Failing to capture host gift searches.
trends.what: Truly and Napa Cellars launched Friendsgiving potluck packs and registries.
trends.why_us: Our box of 6 fits the $18 sweet spot for host gifts.

trends.insight: Hosts prefer curated snack platters over complex from-scratch baking projects.
trends.move: Showcase a two-minute holiday cookie board setup.
trends.name: Curated Platter Replaces Single Bakes
trends.risk: Viewers missing the ease of ready-made boxes.
trends.what: Home cooks share multi-item holiday cookie plates instead of single bakes.
trends.why_us: Our boxes deliver ready-to-serve artisan variety instantly.

trends.insight: Countdown calendars for December gain immense social traction.
trends.move: Pitch the 12-day box to food editors.
trends.name: Artisanal Food Advent Calendars
trends.risk: Missing the early December shipping window.
trends.what: Artisanal food and snack countdowns are surging across social platforms.
trends.why_us: Our 12-day countdown holiday box is built for this exact moment.

trends.insight: Giant cookies with crisp edges and molten centers dominate food creator content.
trends.move: Highlight our thick center bake with break-apart videos.
trends.name: Molten Texture Grabs Spotlight
trends.risk: Failing to visually prove our texture on video.
trends.what: Joshua Weissman recreated Levain's 6-ounce chocolate chip walnut cookie on YouTube.
trends.why_us: Our Brooklyn cookies feature the exact same signature center bake.

trends.insight: Bakery giants are driving massive holiday cookie hype on national television.
trends.move: Pitch local New York food editors our boxes.
trends.name: Bakery Holiday Lineup Debuts
trends.what: Levain co-founders shared new holiday cookie creations on CBS News.
trends.why_us: We bake fresh in Brooklyn with the same thick center.

trends.insight: Shoppers hunt for early holiday deals with up to 40% off curated items.
trends.move: Proactively promote our free shipping threshold.
trends.name: Early Black Friday Food Deals
trends.risk: Shoppers expect sitewide discounts we refuse to run.
trends.what: Major food brands launched early Black Friday promotions offering up to 40% off.
trends.why_us: We never discount cookies, but we offer free shipping on December boxes.

trends.insight: Weekly flavor drop schedules build intense anticipation among snack fans.
trends.move: Tease our weekend flavor drop earlier in the week.
trends.name: Weekly Rotational Cookie Drops
trends.what: Crumbl published its upcoming drop schedule for November 16 through November 21.
trends.why_us: We tease small-batch weekend flavor drops in Brooklyn.

trends.insight: Late-night bakery brands are doubling down on warm delivery branding.
trends.name: Warm Cookie Brand Redesign
trends.risk: Losing visual distinctiveness to chain rebrands.
trends.what: Insomnia Cookies launched a bold new look centering its signature warm cookies.
trends.why_us: Our Brooklyn shop serves fresh-from-the-oven heat daily.

trends.insight: Holiday coupon codes create fatigue among value-seeking consumers.
trends.move: Skip coupon promotions and focus on box gifting value.
trends.name: Veterans Day Promo Overload
trends.risk: Training customers to wait for discounts.
trends.what: Dunkin and Shake Shack offered Veterans Day freebies and meal deals.
trends.why_us: We never discount cookies, protecting our artisanal value.

trends.insight: Pop culture costume coverage crowds out food and retail news cycles.
trends.move: Ignore pop culture gossip and focus entirely on holiday baking.
trends.name: Celebrity Media Frenzy
trends.risk: Diluting our bakery focus with unrelated celebrity chatter.
trends.what: Celebrities dominated entertainment headlines with elaborate Halloween reveals.
trends.why_us: We sell cookies, not pop culture commentary.
